role: Extension of ReanalysisService: sleep retro-apply over all overnight sessions (nap credit included, applied on the archived copy under the archive lock), manual-window reanalysis/apply, sleep-boundary updates (user edits and automatic HealthKit refreshes) with re-classification and re-scoring on the archived copy, training-snapshot repair, and segment unlinking.
types: ReanalysisService.TrainingRepairResult: struct — counts and sample log of a training-snapshot repair
toplevel: Only the three private static constants and TrainingRepairResult (sampleLog defaults '').

units.does: Filters sessions to overnight ones with RR data, re-runs the sleep pipeline for each (stopping on cancellation) counting rewritten sessions, reports progress, notifies archive changed, logs and returns the count.

For one session: end = endDate or start+12 h; fetches fresh sleep (with nap credit), checks shouldRetroApply on the sweep's copy, then hands off to persistRetroApply, which applies, re-classifies, re-scores and writes on the archived copy; returns whether it was written.

Fetches HealthKit sleep for the session (validated against its RR points) and credits the day-before's qualifying nap (fetchDaytimeNapMinutes + withNapSleepMinutes), as the morning path does; nil on error (logged).

branches.effect: true: sleep with napSleepMinutes; false: sleep as fetched
logged and swallowed; return nil so the session is skipped

units.does: Allows retro-apply only when the new sleep has night minutes or stage intervals, the session is not user-adjusted, and the sleep block plausibly overlaps start..sessionEnd.

branches.cond: no night minutes and no stage intervals

units.does: Sets sleepSnapshot, converts the new sleep start/end to rounded ms offsets from sessionStart via MillisecondOffset.between (nil when absent or not representable), writes them clamped to [0, recording duration], and rewrites segments.

branches.cond: clamped start non-nil (new sleep has a start)
branches.effect: overwrite sleepStartMs; nil leaves the old value in place while the snapshot is replaced
overwrite sleepEndMs; nil leaves the old value

units.does: Sets sleepSegments to per-segment ms offsets when the new sleep has >1 segment, else nil.
Recording length in ms for clamping: last beat's endMs, or (end-start) seconds*1000 when no beats.

Runs retroApplied on the archived copy inside SessionArchive.update (one lock, no re-upload stamp), so edits made while the sleep was being fetched are kept; then schedules a CloudKit upload of the written session. False when the update throws (logged) or the skip rules now skip the session.
calls: closure:ReanalysisService.onSessionUploaded — set in RRCollector+Reanalysis.swift:40 to a CloudKitSyncManager upload

branches.cond: update throws (session gone or write failed)

units.does: On the archived copy: re-checks shouldRetroApply (e.g. a sleep edit made meanwhile), then writes the new sleep boundaries/segments/snapshot and re-classifies and re-scores via rescoreAfterSleepChange; returns the copy, or nil when skipped.
units.entry: Closure body of SessionArchive.update in persistRetroApply (runs under the archive lock).

units.does: Starts from the current archived copy of the session (latestArchivedCopy, falling back to the given copy), hydrates it from the archive if lightweight, picks frozen training context (snapshot → result → provider), and asks the pipeline to reanalyze at targetMs with the session's ANS config.

branches.effect: falls back to analysisResult.trainingContext then trainingContextProvider(sessionDate)

units.does: Applies a manually chosen analysis to the current archived copy of the session (latestArchivedCopy, so earlier in-sheet archive writes such as a strap merge or sleep adjustment are kept; falls back to the given copy when not archived): hydrates, marks result isReanalysis with frozen training context, preserves the auto window result/score on the first manual pick, sets windowUserAdjusted, re-classifies the session against the picked window's result (reclassifyHRVQuality), recomputes the deterministic score and persists.

branches.cond: frozen training from snapshot or result

branches.effect: overwrites appliedResult.trainingContext; else keeps the result's own

units.does: Returns the archived copy of the session by id (what the archive holds now, including sleep edits, strap merges or rescores made after a sheet captured its copy); falls back to the given session when it is not archived (retrieve returns nil) or the read throws (logged as a warning).

branches.effect: return it; nil: return the given session
log warning and return the given session

units.does: Sets recoveryScore/scoreBreakdown/frozenReadiness from deterministicRecoveryScore (readiness from the given training).
On the first manual pick only, copies the current analysisResult and recoveryScore into autoWindowResult/autoWindowScore.
Archives the manual result requesting reupload, updates the baseline tracker, notifies archive changed, schedules upload, returns the session; nil on archive error.
calls: closure:ReanalysisService.onSessionUploaded — set in RRCollector+Reanalysis.swift:40 to a CloudKitSyncManager upload

branches.effect: logged; return nil (UI shows Apply failed)

units.does: Updates a session's sleep from SleepData: requires start and end, retrieves the session for the gate, and delegates to applySleepBoundaries, which writes on the archived copy under the archive lock; returns whether it was persisted (false on missing data, missing session, gate rejection or error).

branches.effect: logged at error level; return false

units.does: Computes the new start (>=0) and end offsets, logs, clamps both to the recording (clampedOffsets), applies the automatic-update gate to the clamped duration unless user adjustment, then writes, re-classifies and re-scores on the archived copy (writeSleepUpdate) and reports; returns true when written.

branches.cond: not user adjustment and automatic gate rejects

units.does: Inside SessionArchive.update (one lock; re-upload stamp and request only for user adjustments): writes the clamped boundaries, segments, snapshot and user flag on the archived copy (applyBoundaries), re-classifies and re-scores it (rescoreAfterSleepChange, anchored to endDate ?? startDate); returns the session as written. Throws when the session is no longer archived or the write fails.
Logs the minutes change, notifies archive changed on the main actor and schedules a CloudKit upload of the written session.
calls: closure:ReanalysisService.onSessionUploaded — set in RRCollector+Reanalysis.swift:40 to a CloudKitSyncManager upload

units.does: Logs old/new sleep boundaries and sleep minutes for the update.

Automatic-update gate: rejects when the session is user-adjusted and already has a snapshot, or when the sleep doesn't plausibly overlap the recording; otherwise applies only if the new (clamped) duration exceeds the stored (clamped) one or night minutes exceed the snapshot's.

branches.effect: log, return false (snapshot-nil user-adjusted sessions pass)
recordingEnd = startDate (zero-length recording for the plausibility check)

units.does: Static: both offsets bounded to 0 ... recording length (recordingDurationMs: last beat end, else endDate − startDate) — the bounds SleepBoundaryResolver.clamp applies, for offsets that are always present.
Writes the clamped offsets, per-segment offsets (or nil for a single segment), the sleep snapshot, and sets sleepUserAdjusted for user edits.

branches.effect: build segment offsets; else sleepSegments = nil
sleepUserAdjusted = true; automatic updates leave it

units.does: After a sleep snapshot change (edit, automatic update, retro-apply): re-classifies the session (reclassifyHRVQuality, so .preSleep follows the new sleep), then recomputes recovery score, breakdown and frozen readiness with rescoredBreakdown against the frozen training context, anchored to sessionEnd; logs the new score.

branches.effect: return; sleep changed but quality and score left as before

units.does: For every complete session with an analysis result: rebuilds the training snapshot from HealthKit anchored at 5 AM on its end day, persists it, counts repaired/nil/errors (stops on cancellation), reports progress, notifies archive changed and returns the result.

branches.effect: break; final progress still reported as complete

units.does: Logs candidate count, per-state session counts and complete-without-analysis count.

Calculates training load at the morning anchor, builds a TrainingContext (counts nilContext and returns if nil), applies VO2max preference, appends a sample log line, persists; counts repaired or errors.
Returns 05:00 local on the start of day of the session's end (or start) date; start of day if Calendar returns nil.
VO2max override from settings wins; otherwise clears vo2Max unless useHealthKitVO2Max is on.

branches.effect: vo2Max = nil; else keep HealthKit value

units.does: For the first 3 processed sessions, appends 'date: ATL old→new CTL old→new' to the result's sampleLog.

Inside SessionArchive.update (one lock, no re-upload stamp): writes trainingSnapshot and analysisResult.trainingContext on the archived copy and recomputes frozenReadiness when a breakdown exists; then schedules a CloudKit upload of the written copy. Throws when the session is no longer archived or the write fails.
calls: closure:ReanalysisService.onSessionUploaded — set in RRCollector+Reanalysis.swift:40 to a CloudKitSyncManager upload

units.does: Strips the segment's beats from the parent's merged series, then removes segmentId from linkedSessionIds, archives with reupload, reanalyzes asynchronously and schedules upload; returns true. Returns false with nothing written (link kept) when the parent or link is missing, when the segment can't be read so its beats can't be located, or when retrieve/archive throws (logged). Callers today discard the result.
calls: closure:ReanalysisService.onSessionUploaded — set in RRCollector+Reanalysis.swift:40 to a CloudKitSyncManager upload

branches.cond: no links or segment not linked

units.does: Loads the unlinked segment, computes its window relative to the parent series start, and replaces the parent series with points outside [segStart, segEnd]; returns true. False (logged at error level) only when the segment can't be read; a parent with no beats or a segment with no span has nothing to strip and returns true.
Segment length in ms from its duration, else the last beat's t_ms, else 0.
Spawns a Task that reanalyzes the session, logs the outcome, and notifies archive changed.

branches.effect: log prints -1.0; nil result → log that only stripped data was archived
